metadata.description: GET /api/mam/apps/internal/{applicationId}, live-captured via mock-capture against the configured test org group on the 26.2.0.0 test tenant, 2026-07-30, immediately after the apk create captured in internal_app_create_apk.json (same app instance, before delete). The real live-captured id was anonymized here to 67001 AND baked in as a literal path (not the {applicationId} template) deliberately: internal/mockserver's RequestMatcher.pathMatchScore scores an exact literal path higher than a template match (matcher.go), which is the established pattern this codebase already uses for id-shaped collision avoidance (see testdata/mock-responses/profiles/profiles_apple_get_after_create.json's literal '/api/mdm/profiles/68910'). Without this, this fixture would silently shadow the pre-existing testdata/mock-responses/mam-apps/apps_get_internal_ios_renewaldate.json fixture (same method+endpoint+version, matched by score-tie-goes-to-first-loaded) in every test that loads the full ../testdata/mock-responses tree -- confirmed by hitting exactly that regression during this work before switching to a literal id. Casing note: this GET path uses {applicationId} (capital I) in the real API; the DELETE path is a separate internal codegen config path entry using lowercase {applicationid} -- see delete_internal_app_apk.json.
